hypothesis: The reserve-inventory step serializes reservations with a lock, but the default locking provider is InMemoryLockingProvider, which only lives inside one server process. With two servers on one database, two carts for the single SOLO unit (stock 1) can each pass the available_quantity check in createReservationItems_ and each write reserved_quantity from a stale read, so both orders get the unit. I expect no_oversell to fail (and possibly reserved_matches_reservations) in some runs.
